definitions.gloss: going around in circles; getting nowhere; vicious circle
definitions.explanation: A situation where discussion, thinking, or efforts keep returning to the same point without making progress. Also used for circular reasoning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{堂々巡|どうどうめぐ}り⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The discussion is going around in circles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{堂々巡|どうどうめぐ}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{疲|つか}れた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧。
examples.english: I'm tired of going round and round on the same topic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{考|かんが}えれば→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧ほど{堂々巡|どうどうめぐ}りになって、⟦{結論|けつろん}→結論：02704_ketsuron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ない→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The more I think about it, the more I go in circles, and I can't reach a conclusion.

notes:
Originally referred to a ritual where priests walk in circles around a temple hall ({堂|どう}). Now used figuratively for any unproductive repetition. Common in contexts of debate, decision-making, and overthinking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {堂々巡|どうどうめぐ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to end up going in circles
- {堂々巡|どうどうめぐ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧: to keep going in circles
- ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{堂々巡|どうどうめぐ}り: circular debate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- いたちごっこ: cat-and-mouse game — both sides act without progress
- {千日手|せんにちて}: stalemate (from shogi) — deadlock
- ⟦{悪循環|あくじゅんかん}→悪循環：12668_akujunkan⟧: vicious cycle — more formal
